title: Showtime — The Story Is Ours
summary: Interactive cinema where the whole room votes on what happens next — and the launch campaign that brings people in, from bus shelters to the Instagram grid.
overview: Showtime is interactive cinema: one screen, one room, and an audience that decides the story together from their phones. We built the brand and its launch campaign, "The Story Is Ours", across out-of-home and social — a film-noir world held together by a single graphic device, a red dot that becomes the choice point in every frame.

cover.alt: Five Showtime posters lit up in a city bus shelter at dusk on a wet street, with lines like Same screen. A different story. and You're in.

challenge.heading: The challenge
body: Interactive cinema is a new kind of night out. People need to understand at a glance that this isn't streaming at home and isn't a regular movie — it's a story the whole room decides, live.

idea.heading: The brand
body: The choice is the hero. The O in SHOWTIME is a red dot that branches into paths — A, B or C — so the logo explains the experience before anyone reads a word. Lines like "Same screen. A different story.", "Every choice a new story." and "You're in." do the rest.

A noir palette of black, cream and cinema red keeps every touchpoint recognisable, from a five-panel bus shelter sequence ending in a QR code ("Scan. Choose. Watch together.") to a six-post Instagram launch and the popcorn and cup packaging in the lobby.

execution.heading: Deliverables
body: Brand mark and tagline, a five-poster out-of-home series, a six-post social launch with captions and hashtags, and concession packaging.
